text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *pant! pant! pant! pant!*

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I'll win so convincingly that everyone marks me as a threat!
I'll win with so much sparkle and shine that Ai-chan won't be able to look away!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
For Senpai's sake, I'll win and shine—
Go get 'eeem, meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I did ittttttttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Following up her Queen Elizabeth II Cup victory, she's captured the Victoria Mile as well!
It's Fusaichi Pandoraaa!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ――Haha, ahaha! Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay!!
We won, we won!! All right!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Not bad, Pandora!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Especially since, up until the Classic Year, she had such a laid-back vibe...
Lately, her drive has been insane!

A massive roar of cheers erupts, hyping up the crowd.
Among them is an Umamusume who just made her debut—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that gave me chills!
Coming to the racecourse to watch in person was definitely the right call!
Daiwa Scarlet, the confident, honor student Umamusume who won't settle for anything less than first place, and—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That's insane, I can't let myself lose! Next time, I wanna show everyone what "I'm" made of just like that!

Vodka, a prodigiously talented Umamusume
who yearned to be cool, was also there.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I wonder why. I kind of feel like...
I was able to run right alongside them, just a little.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Pandora-san!
...And thank you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations—Pandora.
...Fufu, I suppose I got what I deserved.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Running with you made me realize.
I had uncharacteristically become so pessimistic.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Chasing only afterimages,
and forgetting to look ahead.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Heart-chan...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Gloomy moods are strictly forbidden!
—Congratulations, truly.
You were shining so brilliantly, Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: A brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, seriously!? You really, really think so!?
Enough to make you wanna follow my lead!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: W-What is it, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I want to shine—and guide someone forward!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm running for that kid's future!
So today, like, for real, I super want to win
for that reason too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"If Heart-chan thought it was sparkling that much,
I'm like, seriously super happy...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...!
Fufu, ahaha! So that's what it is!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
True. I'm not "her," so I wouldn't really know for sure, but...
Well, it wasn't half bad.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...!
I see... Heheh. Hehehe...!

Fusaichi Pandora's strength was etched deep
into the hearts of many spectators—and so,
the Victoria Mile drew to a close!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aaaahn♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' beats grease and salt, right? ♡
I've been eatin' nothin' but health food lately, so this hits the spot~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mm! It's from Ai-chanâ¡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "I watched the Victoria Mile on my break. Great job out there."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You climbed even higher!
I can't let myself fall behind, either!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“'I'm looking forward to your next race too'...
...is what they said!!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, so hap-py♡
I'll totes do my best next time too...♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Next—a magnificent grand stage that suits Fusaichi Pandora's running style and lets her brilliance shine would be...
choice_data_list: How about going for back-to-back Queen Elizabeth II Cup wins?
How about going for back-to-back Queen Elizabeth II Cup wins?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that way too amazing?!
Love it, that's the one I want!
"Even so, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup isn't until November. That's a pretty long gap. We should set another target race before then."
choice_data_list: (If only there were a suitable race somewhere...)

text_block_list.text:
—The Sapporo Kinen.
A GII race held in Hokkaido
as part of the late-August regional circuit.

Though classed as a Gâ¡ race, every year it attracts a field of Gâ -caliber Umamusumeâ
Plus, it fits nicely into our race rotation.
choice_data_list: Pandora, how about running in the Sapporo Kinen?
Pandora, want to run in the Sapporo Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The Sapporo Kinen, huh?
Sounds fine to me..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait, so that means a trip to Hokkaido!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Omg, yeees!! I wanna eat ice cream at Maruyama Park,
go to the zoo, and take photos at Moiwa Terrace♡
Oh, and Clark too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I'm so happy~♡
Can't wait, Trainer♡

...Regardless, the next target race is the Sapporo Kinen.
I want to leave a strong mark in the northern lands ahead of the autumn showdown!
